domains.rationale: Cannot be tiered until the source census names the system(s) that hold parts and their volume. Verenward has not assumed Taylor's parts catalogue moves on Day 1.
Cannot be tiered until the source census names the system(s) that hold customers and which is authoritative where more than one does.
Cannot be tiered until the source census names the system(s) that hold equipment and whether serialized identity is recorded there.
Cannot be tiered until the source census names the system(s) that hold inventory. Opening balances are additionally gated on C1-INV-01, which is Taylor's to accept.
Cannot be tiered until the source census names the system(s) that hold purchasing and whether open purchase orders exist at cutover.
Cannot be tiered until the source census names the system(s) that hold service history and how far back Taylor needs it readable.
